players.bio: Adam John Forshaw (born 8 October 1991) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Blackburn Rovers. Forshaw began his career in the academy at Premier League side Everton and came to prominence at Brentford, with whom he won the 2013–14 League One Player of the Year award.
Andri Lucas Guðjohnsen (born 29 January 2002) is an Icelandic professional footballer who plays as a centre forward for EFL Championship side Blackburn Rovers and the Iceland national team.
Augustus Kargbo (born 24 August 1999) is a Sierra Leonean professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Blackburn Rovers.
Per Axel Nils Henriksson is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Danish Superliga club Randers FC on loan from EFL Championship club Blackburn Rovers.

Aynsley Alan William Pears (born 23 April 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Blackburn Rovers. Early life Pears is the son of former Middlesbrough goalkeeper Stephen Pears. Club career Middlesbrough On 17 January 2018, Pears was loaned out to Darlington, first for one month, then again for the remainder of the season.
Balázs Tóth (born 4 September 1997) is a Hungarian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Blackburn Rovers.
Dion De Neve (born 12 June 2001) is a Belgian footballer who plays as a winger or wing-back for EFL Championship club Blackburn Rovers.
Blackburn Rovers U21
Gady-Pierre Beyuku Bowutankoyi (born 23 November 2005) is a French professional footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL Championship club Blackburn Rovers.
Harry Leslie Pickering (born 29 December 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for Blackburn Rovers.

Hayden James Carter (born 17 December 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for Blackburn Rovers. Born in Stockport, Carter played youth football with Manchester City before switching to Blackburn Rovers in 2014. In June 2020, Carter signed a new two-year deal at Rovers. In July 2020, he made his senior debut against Reading playing the full game in a 4-3 win.

Jake Joseph Garrett (born 10 March 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL Championship club Blackburn Rovers. Having played for Merseyside clubs Liverpool and Everton, Garrett joined Blackburn Rovers's academy at the age of nine. He signed his first professional contract in March 2020.

Jayden Raymond Fevrier is an English professional footballer who plays as a right winger or right wing-back for EFL Championship club Blackburn Rovers. Jayden has played in multiple positions for Colchester including left wing-back, right wing-back and more advanced on both flanks.

Kristi Julian Montgomery (born 31 May 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship side Blackburn Rovers. He has played for the Scotland under-21 team. Career On 29 June 2022, Montgomery signed his first professional contract a two-year deal until 2024, with the option of a further 12 months.
Lewis Miller is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a right back for Blackburn Rovers and the Australia national team.
Mathias Jørgensen is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL Championship club Blackburn Rovers.
Moussa Baradji is a 25-year-old French professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for English EFL Championship club Blackburn Rovers F.C..
Oladapo Joshua Afolayan Listen is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger or centre-forward for EFL Championship club Blackburn Rovers.
Ryan Alebiosu (born 17 December 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a right back for EFL Championship club Blackburn Rovers. Born in England, he represents Nigeria at international level.
Ryōya Morishita is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or winger for EFL Championship club Blackburn Rovers and the Japan national team.

Samy Sayed Mekkawy Saied Morsy (born 10 September 1991) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL Championship club Blackburn Rovers. Born and raised in England, he has gained nine caps for the Egypt national team.
Scott Bradley Wharton (born 3 October 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for Blackburn Rovers.

Sean Desmond McLoughlin (born 13 November 1996) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Blackburn Rovers. Club career Born in Cork, McLoughlin signed for Cork City in 2013 after previously playing for Springfield Ramblers. He moved to College Corinthians in 2015, returning to Cork City in 2017 after a spell with UCC.

Todd Owen Cantwell (born 27 February 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Blackburn Rovers. Cantwell began his career at Norwich City, joining the club at under-10 level in 2008 and making his first-team debut in January 2018. He made 129 appearances for Norwich over six seasons and had loan spells at Fortuna Sittard and AFC Bournemouth.
Tom Joseph Atcheson (born 22 September 2006) is a Northern Irish professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Blackburn Rovers and the Northern Ireland national team.

Anthony Mark Mowbray (born 22 November 1963) is an English football manager and former footballer who is currently the head coach of EFL Championship club Blackburn Rovers. Mowbray played for Middlesbrough, Celtic and Ipswich Town as a defender.

Yuki Ohashi is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a forward for Blackburn Rovers. Playing career Ohashi was born in Chiba Prefecture on July 27, 1996. He joined J1 League club Shonan Bellmare in 2018. He joined J1 League club Sanfrecce Hiroshima for the 2024 season.
Yuri Oliveira Ribeiro (born 24 January 1997) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a left-back or wing-back for EFL Championship club Blackburn Rovers.
